title: hedyotis prainiana
intro: Hedyotis prainiana, commonly known as Thai motherwort or Thai prain, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual disorders. The health benefits of Hedyotis prainiana include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation and reducing stress. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis prainiana include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
